```lean
theorem lg_target {k : ℕ} {x : ℝ} (hk : k ≠ 0) (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) : HurwitzZeta.hurwitzZeta (↑x) (-↑k) = -1 / (↑k + 1) * Polynomial.eval (↑x) (Polynomial.map (algebraMap ℚ ℂ) (Polynomial.bernoulli (k + 1))) := by
  let s := -(↑k : ℝ)
  let a := ↑x
  let ha : a ∈ Set.Icc 0 1 := hx
  let hs : ∀ (n : ℕ), s ≠ -↑n := by intro n; simp [s, n]
  let hs' : a ≠ 0 ∨ s ≠ 1 := by simp [a, s]
  have h : HurwitzZeta.hurwitzZeta a (1 - s) = (2 * ↑Real.pi) ^ (-s) * Complex.Gamma s * (Complex.exp (-↑Real.pi * Complex.I * s / 2) * HurwitzZeta.hurwitzZeta a s + Complex.exp (↑Real.pi * Complex.I * s / 2) * HurwitzZeta.hurwitzZeta (1 - a) s) :=
    HurwitzZeta.hurwitzZeta_one_sub a s hs hs'
  let h1 : HurwitzZeta.hurwitzZeta a (1 - s) = HurwitzZeta.hurwitzZeta a (1 + ↑k) := by simp [s]
  let h2 : HurwitzZeta.hurwitzZeta (1 - a) s = HurwitzZeta.hurwitzZeta (1 - a) (-↑k) := by simp [s]
  let h3 : HurwitzZeta.hurwitzZeta a (1 + ↑k) = -1 / (↑k + 1) * Polynomial.eval a (Polynomial.map (algebraMap ℚ ℂ) (Polynomial.bernoulli (k + 1))) :=
    by apply HurwitzZeta.hasSum_hurwitzZeta_of_one_lt_re; assumption; exact (Polynomial.bernoulli_sum k a).symm
  let h4 : HurwitzZeta.hurwitzZeta (1 - a) (-↑k) = -1 / (↑k + 1) * Polynomial.eval (1 - a) (Polynomial.map (algebraMap ℚ ℂ) (Polynomial.bernoulli (k + 1))) :=
    by apply HurwitzZeta.hasSum_hurwitzZeta_of_one_lt_re; assumption; exact (Polynomial.bernoulli_sum k (1 - a)).symm
  let h5 : Polynomial.eval a (Polynomial.map (algebraMap ℚ ℂ) (Polynomial.bernoulli (k + 1))) = Polynomial.eval (1 - a) (Polynomial.map (algebraMap ℚ ℂ) (Polynomial.bernoulli (k + 1))) :=
    by rw [Polynomial.eval_add]; simp [a, 1 - a]
  have h6 : HurwitzZeta.hurwitzZeta a (-↑k) = -1 / (↑k + 1) * Polynomial.eval a (Polynomial.map (algebraMap ℚ ℂ) (Polynomial.bernoulli (k + 1))) :=
    by rw [h, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5]
  exact h6
```
